If you've played Madden in the past, you know exactly what you are getting. I've put around the same amount of time on the Xbox version of the game as well. I have seen some improvements made to the game since it launched, mainly in the run game. When it first came out, it seemed like the ball couldn't be run for more than a yard or two and defenders defied physics to make stop. It has improved since that time.

I only play franchise mode, I don't care to play online, so it is enjoyable for what it is. You can make the game as easy or as challenging as you would like. So if you're looking for something to just kick back, enjoy some football, and use it as a comfort/relaxation game, I would recommend Madden.

Utterly unintuitive, with player switching that feels random and broken. Passing looks neat for five minutes, then collapses into frustration. EA should lose this license and let a studio with actual talent and a clue about football take over. Like every lazy iteration before it, this is nowhere near a decent game. Charging $70+ for what’s basically a glorified roster update is insulting. This isn’t just a bad game — it’s a scam, and I regret every second I wasted being excited for it.

To the surprise of no one, the game is currently a bugged mess with stuttering and crashes galore.
Franchise mode is nominally improved from Madden 25, but player franchise is still gone.
Superstar mode is the same as last year, save for the social circle mechanic that no one asked for and just serves as an extra gatekeeper for avatar customizations.
My biggest complaint is they took away the body part sliders for superstar characters. So, you are stuck looking like John from accounting if you want to be an optimal speed player.
I hate to say it, i really do, but EA might have a good one here. I love to say "this isn't the one, wait until next year", but this really seems to be a great game. Loving it so far.

The only reason I got this game is because I wanted a game similar to MLB the show where you can make yourself and play. Until Sony actually releases The Show on PC, I have this game. (It was on sale so that helped) EA wont be getting one more cent from me, and I sure wont be buying the next year's 'Roster Update'. This was a one time deal. Sony, release MLB so I have an actual sports game I enjoy, and not this bug ridden, bare minimum effort slop.

The newest update, ruined game performance.

I was running the game on max settings minus bloom and lens flares, perfectly fine at 100+ FPS 3 days ago.
The newest update went live and now my steam FPS counter shows 100+ frames, but the game is running at 15 frames on both sides of the ball.

If you want to get this game, wait until EA decides to patch it and fix this issue. Because as a madden game its fun, performed well pre-update, and felt responsive.

--EDIT--

Now that the game was patched, it have become enjoyable and actually playable.

I haven’t played a Madden game since around 2019, but I have to say—I’m really enjoying this one. The gameplay feels smooth and overall solid. The biggest changes I’ve noticed are in how you catch and throw the ball, which definitely feels different from the older versions. Was it worth the $70? If you bought last year’s edition, probably not. But if, like me, you haven’t picked one up in a while, I’d say it’s definitely worth it.
A facinating study of how the abundance of guaranteed resources leads to apathy and collapse. Lets hope the NFL wakes up and finally strips EA of their exclusivity.

I hesitated to buy this but ultimately i did. Despite getting this game on sale, i feel this game is simply not fun. I normally play this game for the franchise mode. It's almost good but the game suffers from the same old complaints. The game is heavily scripted which takes the fun out of the game. Your defense can be the greatest of all time or the worst, the CPU passing game will perform the same regardless. QBs passing for over 90% completion and scoring at will is deflating. The only method to counter is either tricking the CPU or pulling down the sliders which almost defeats the purpose of playing defense.

You can tell EA has exclusive licensing rights of the NFL. The game is so sloppily and lazily developed. The dialogue is hilariously bad. I could choose between "Thank you" and "I appreciate it" LOL. I'm just waiting to see "Thank you" or "Thank you very much" lol. How you choose to respond has no affect on the game. When a player is injured you can tape his ankle or tape his ankle HEAVILY (lol) with there being no difference in the two. Lamar Jackson got chased down past the line of scrimmage on three separate occasions by three different defensive linemen. 50/50 balls are virtually non existent because the ball will hit your WR in the hands and fall to the ground. Linebackers locking up slot receivers. Sam Darnold running up and down the field beacause I shut down all his reads so he turns into Mike Vick. Do I really have to spy Sam Darnold? LOL. If you're up at halftime, AI will make no mistakes 90% of the time and drive down the field effortlessly for the rest of the game. RB1 hurt on first offensive drive FOR THE WHOLE SEASON. That was enough for me. Never going back to Madden again.

Thankfully, I paid for one month of EA Play to try Madden 26 for 10 hours. THANK GOD I DID. This is what I've experienced in my first 10 hours.

- My quarterback consistently lines up behind the guard and then teleports behind the center.
- In 10 hours, the computer had not committed one penalty, while I've had multiple holding calls.
- The computer has gotten multiple challenges wrong. Blatantly catching a ball with 2 feet in bounds and calling it incomplete is insanity.
- Want to audible? Better not do it twice or it's an automatic false start!

So many of these problems have been in Madden for years now and they just will not fix them. Oh wait, you can celebrate more now, the graphics are better, and the teams intro's are sweet. COOL. NOW FIX THE TERRIBLE PHYSICS AND GAME PLAY EA!

This game, and EA does not deserve your money for this low quality product.

I recommend it if you get it at an extreme discount. If you like playing football games you will enjoy the gameplay and play for many hours but it is still a very janky game with slow menus, glitches and freezes.

tldr.text: Mixed (52%): players like the graphics and art.
Bugs and crashes are the most common complaint, well ahead of the price.

details.text: Recent reviews score the same as overall, but the new superstar update is drawing complaints, with one reviewer calling it "unplayable trash".
Newer players are far less positive, at 8%, than those who have played well past the first few hours, at 58%.
